title: On Cohesive Products of Fields
summary: We develop the foundations of effective ultraproducts of fields and their Galois groups using the methods of computability theory. These computability-theoretic analogs of ultraproducts are called cohesive products, since the role of an ultrafilter is played by a cohesive set. A set of natural numbers is cohesive if it is infinite and cannot be partitioned into two infinite subsets by any computably enumerable set.
